class.name: DSErrorHandler
class.brief_description: Asynchronous error bridge for DirectStorage kernel events.
class.description: [DSErrorHandler] registers a Windows Threadpool wait on DirectStorage error events. When a background I/O error occurs, it retrieves [code]DSTORAGE_ERROR_RECORD[/code] diagnostics and routes error messages to Godot's Output panel via [method push_error].

method.name: clear_error
method.description: Clears the last recorded error state.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the string description of the last asynchronous DirectStorage failure.

method.name: has_error
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an asynchronous error has been flagged.

method.name: report_error
method.description: Manually flags and reports an error message to the error handler.
